title: Corporate Brand lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Corporate Brand templates were built and verified in: chapter title, quote, end card, agenda, team row, split screen, leader callout and a two-colour panel wipe.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 corporate template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. Portraits and the split-screen photo are grey/navy stand-ins.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg". The light comps also have a 'Light background' that stays in the template.
Clip ids are unique per comp (cch_, cqt_, cec_, cag_, ctm_, css_, clc_, cpw_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/corporate_brand_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
